Incident review: checkout outage on 12 March.

Between 09:40 and 10:25 UTC, about 18% of checkout attempts failed with a payment timeout. The cause was a configuration change that lowered the connection pool of the payment service from 200 to 20 connections. The change was meant for the staging environment but was applied to production by a deployment script that read the wrong environment variable.

On-call engineers noticed the error rate at 09:52 from an alert, rolled back the configuration at 10:18, and checkout recovered fully by 10:25. Roughly 1,400 orders failed; 1,100 customers retried successfully within the hour. Support received 86 tickets.

Follow-up actions agreed in the review: the deployment script will refuse to run when the target environment does not match the branch; connection-pool size gets its own alert; and support will email the 300 customers who did not complete their order, with a 10% voucher. Owners are the platform team for the first two items and the support lead for the email, all due by 26 March.
